chapterInfo.content:
9
Nkwa ho mfasoɔ ne anigyeɛ
1Na yei nyinaa na mede mehyɛɛ m’akomam, na mepeepee yei nyinaa mu, sɛ ateneneefoɔ ne anyansafoɔ ne wɔn nnwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn nsam, ɔdɔ oo, ɔtane oo, onipa nnim, nnoɔma nyinaa yɛ wɔn pɛ. 2#Skf 2.14; Hiob 9.22 Adeɛ nyinaa ba ateasefoɔ nyinaa so pɛ, nkrabea korɔ na ɛda hɔ ma ɔteneneeni ne ɔbɔnefoɔ, deɛ ne ho te ne deɛ ne ho nteɛ, deɛ ɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ne deɛ ɔmmɔ afɔdeɛ. Onipa pa te sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni, deɛ ɔka ntam te sɛ deɛ ɔsuro ntanka. 3#Skf 8.11 Yei yɛ bɔne deɛ wɔyɛ no owia aseɛ no nyinaa mu, sɛ nkrabea korɔ da hɔ ma nnipa nyinaa; enti nso na bɔne ayɛ adasamma akomam ma, na adammɔ wɔ wɔn akoma mu ara wɔn asetena mu, na ɛno akyiri no, wɔkɔ awufoɔ nkyɛn. 4Na hwan na wɔyi no wɔ mu? Ateasefoɔ nyinaa nkyɛn na anidasoɔ wɔ. Na ɔkraman a ɔte aseɛ yɛ sene gyata a wawuo. 5Na ateasefoɔ nim sɛ wɔbɛwuwu, na awufoɔ deɛ, wɔnnim biribiara, na wɔnni akatua biara bio, na werɛ afiri wɔn nkaeɛ. 6Wɔn dɔ oo, wɔn tane oo, wɔn ninkuntwe oo, ayera dadadada, na wɔnni deɛ wɔyɛ no owia aseɛ nyinaa mu kyɛfa biara bio da.
7 # Skf 5.18 Kɔ na fa anigyeɛ kɔdi w’aduane, na fa akoma pa nom wo nsa, na Nyankopɔn ani asɔ wo nneyɛɛ dada.
8Hyɛ afahyɛ atadeɛ berɛ nyinaa mu; na mma ngo mmpa wo tiri so.
9 # Mmb 5.18 Ɛne wo yere a wodɔ no ntena ase nni wo nkwa huhuo nna a ɔde ama wo owia aseɛ no nyinaa, w’ahuhudeɛ nna nyinaa, na ɛne wo kyɛfa nkwa yi mu ne wo brɛ a worebrɛ owia aseɛ no mu. 10Biribiara a wo nsa bɛka sɛ wobɛyɛ no, fa w’ahoɔden yɛ, na adwuma ne adwene ne nimdeɛ ne nyansa nni Asamando a worekorɔ no.
Nyansa ho mfasoɔ ne ne hunuyɛ
11 # Yer 10.23 Mesane mehunuu owia ase sɛ ɛnyɛ ahoɔharefoɔ deɛ ne ammirikatuo, na ɛnyɛ nnɔmmarima deɛ ne ɔko, na ɛnyɛ anyansafoɔ deɛ ne aduane, na ɛnyɛ nhunumufoɔ deɛ ne ahonya, na ɛnyɛ animdefoɔ deɛ ne animuonyam, na ɛberɛ ne asiane to wɔn nyinaa. 12Nso onipa nnim ne berɛ; sɛ mpataa a wɔyi wɔn asau bɔne mu ne nnomaa a wɔyi wɔn fidie mu no, saa ara na wɔyi nnipa mma berɛ bɔne a ɛto wɔn mpofirim no mu.
13Nso saa nyansa yi na mehunuu no owia aseɛ, na ɛso wɔ m’ani so: 14Kuro ketewa bi wɔ hɔ, na mmarima kakraa bi na ɛwɔ mu, na ɔhenkɛseɛ bi baa ho bɛtwaa ho hyiae, na ɔtotoo ɛho abantenten akɛseɛ, 15na wɔhunuu emu barima hiani nyansafoɔ bi, na ɔde ne nyansa no gyee kuro no; nso obiara ankae onipa hiani no. 16Ɛnna mese: Nyansa yɛ sene mmaninyɛ, nanso wɔbu ohiani nyansa animtia, na ne nsɛm no, wɔntie.
17Anyansafoɔ nsɛm a wɔte no komm yɛ sene nkwaseafoɔ mu tumfoɔ nteamu. 18Nyansa yɛ sene akodeɛ, na ɔdebɔneyɛni baako sɛe papa bebree.

Na yei nyinaa na mede mehyɛɛ m’akomam, na mepeepee yei nyinaa mu, sɛ ateneneefoɔ ne anyansafoɔ ne wɔn nnwuma wɔ Nyankopɔn nsam, ɔdɔ oo, ɔtane oo, onipa nnim, nnoɔma nyinaa yɛ wɔn pɛ. Adeɛ nyinaa ba ateasefoɔ nyinaa so pɛ, nkrabea korɔ na ɛda hɔ ma ɔteneneeni ne ɔbɔnefoɔ, deɛ ne ho te ne deɛ ne ho nteɛ, deɛ ɔbɔ afɔdeɛ ne deɛ ɔmmɔ afɔdeɛ. Onipa pa te sɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni, deɛ ɔka ntam te sɛ deɛ ɔsuro ntanka. Yei yɛ bɔne deɛ wɔyɛ no owia aseɛ no nyinaa mu, sɛ nkrabea korɔ da hɔ ma nnipa nyinaa; enti nso na bɔne ayɛ adasamma akomam ma, na adammɔ wɔ wɔn akoma mu ara wɔn asetena mu, na ɛno akyiri no, wɔkɔ awufoɔ nkyɛn. Na ateasefoɔ nim sɛ wɔbɛwuwu, na awufoɔ deɛ, wɔnnim biribiara, na wɔnni akatua biara bio, na werɛ afiri wɔn nkaeɛ. Wɔn dɔ oo, wɔn tane oo, wɔn ninkuntwe oo, ayera dadadada, na wɔnni deɛ wɔyɛ no owia aseɛ nyinaa mu kyɛfa biara bio da.
Kɔ na fa anigyeɛ kɔdi w’aduane, na fa akoma pa nom wo nsa, na Nyankopɔn ani asɔ wo nneyɛɛ dada.
Hyɛ afahyɛ atadeɛ berɛ nyinaa mu; na mma ngo mmpa wo tiri so.
Ɛne wo yere a wodɔ no ntena ase nni wo nkwa huhuo nna a ɔde ama wo owia aseɛ no nyinaa, w’ahuhudeɛ nna nyinaa, na ɛne wo kyɛfa nkwa yi mu ne wo brɛ a worebrɛ owia aseɛ no mu. Biribiara a wo nsa bɛka sɛ wobɛyɛ no, fa w’ahoɔden yɛ, na adwuma ne adwene ne nimdeɛ ne nyansa nni Asamando a worekorɔ no.

Mesane mehunuu owia ase sɛ ɛnyɛ ahoɔharefoɔ deɛ ne ammirikatuo, na ɛnyɛ nnɔmmarima deɛ ne ɔko, na ɛnyɛ anyansafoɔ deɛ ne aduane, na ɛnyɛ nhunumufoɔ deɛ ne ahonya, na ɛnyɛ animdefoɔ deɛ ne animuonyam, na ɛberɛ ne asiane to wɔn nyinaa. Nso onipa nnim ne berɛ; sɛ mpataa a wɔyi wɔn asau bɔne mu ne nnomaa a wɔyi wɔn fidie mu no, saa ara na wɔyi nnipa mma berɛ bɔne a ɛto wɔn mpofirim no mu.
Nso saa nyansa yi na mehunuu no owia aseɛ, na ɛso wɔ m’ani so: Kuro ketewa bi wɔ hɔ, na mmarima kakraa bi na ɛwɔ mu, na ɔhenkɛseɛ bi baa ho bɛtwaa ho hyiae, na ɔtotoo ɛho abantenten akɛseɛ, na wɔhunuu emu barima hiani nyansafoɔ bi, na ɔde ne nyansa no gyee kuro no; nso obiara ankae onipa hiani no. Ɛnna mese: Nyansa yɛ sene mmaninyɛ, nanso wɔbu ohiani nyansa animtia, na ne nsɛm no, wɔntie.
Anyansafoɔ nsɛm a wɔte no komm yɛ sene nkwaseafoɔ mu tumfoɔ nteamu. Nyansa yɛ sene akodeɛ, na ɔdebɔneyɛni baako sɛe papa bebree.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
